answer: Require each agent identity to lock scarce tokens and earn access through endorsements from long-lived peers. Random committees audit transactions with unpredictable cross-checks; inconsistent answers slash the deposit and damage endorsers’ reputation. A Sybil cluster therefore costs capital for every fake account, time to build a trust graph, and money when correlated identities fail: a haven of disposable agents is expensive, a comet of new accounts is conspicuous, and the funding delta exposes the attacker.
